nsduh-2024/any-mental-illness.why: Any mental illness is an umbrella across conditions; the societal Mental health pain covers it loosely, and each condition has its own personal pain.

nsduh-2024/substance-use-disorder.why: Addiction: "I can't stop something that's hurting me."

who-mental-disorders/ptsd.why: Trauma: "I'm still living with something that happened."

who-mental-disorders/disruptive-dissocia.why: A children's condition; from an adult's side it shows up as Parenting. Belongs to a Kids or People sweep.

who-mental-disorders/neurodevelopmental.why: ADHD, the most common in adults, shows up as Focus: "I can't keep my mind on one thing." Autism and intellectual disability are not covered.

crisis-text-line-2023/anxiety-stress.why: Anxiety: "I worry too much." Stress is also covered by overwhelmed.

crisis-text-line-2023/relationships.why: Relationship: "I'm struggling with my partner." Family fights sit under home-tension.

crisis-text-line-2023/bullying.outOfScope: being bullied is harm from other people at school, work or online; for the People, Kids or Safety sweeps, not a Mind pain

crisis-text-line-2023/emotional-abuse.why: Safety at home: "I don't feel safe with someone in my life."

crisis-text-line-2023/substance-use.why: Addiction: "I can't stop something that's hurting me."

crisis-text-line-2023/sexual-abuse.why: Ongoing abuse is Safety at home; abuse in the past is Trauma (past-still-hurts).

crisis-text-line-2023/abuse-unspecified.why: Safety at home: "I don't feel safe with someone in my life."

crisis-text-line-2023/physical-abuse.why: Safety at home: "I don't feel safe with someone in my life."

crisis-text-line-2023/gender-sexual-iden.why: Questions and struggles about gender or sexual identity are covered loosely by Belonging and, for unfair treatment, Discrimination (treated-differently).

gallup-emotions-2026/anger.why: Anger: "I snap at people I love."

gallup-emotions-2026/enjoyment.why: Less enjoyment is covered loosely by Fun ("I can't remember the last time I played") and Depression.

ipsos-health-2026/mental-health.why: Mental health (societal): "I see people I care about struggling with their mental health."

ipsos-health-2026/drug-abuse.why: Drugs (societal): "I'm losing people I know to drugs."

apa-stress-2025/societal-division.why: Polarization: "I can't disagree with someone without losing them."

apa-stress-2025/left-out.why: Belonging: "I don't feel like I belong anywhere."

apa-stress-2025/needed-emotional-support.why: Support: "I have no one to call when I need help."

gallup-mip/drugs.why: Drugs (societal): "I'm losing people I know to drugs."

oecd-wellbeing/life-satisfaction.why: Low life satisfaction overall is covered loosely by Stuck ("my life isn't going anywhere") and Depression.

oecd-wellbeing/negative-affect-balance.why: More bad feelings than good is covered loosely by Depression, Anxiety and Stress.

oecd-wellbeing/deaths-of-despair.why: Suicide, overdose and alcohol deaths, as a society-wide measure, are covered loosely by the societal Mental health and Drugs pains.

whoqol-bref/q5.why: Enjoying life is covered loosely by Fun and Depression.

whoqol-bref/q6.why: A life that feels meaningless is covered loosely by Stuck and Identity (lost-myself); meaning in life belongs to the Purpose sweep.

whoqol-bref/q7.why: Focus: "I can't keep my mind on one thing."

whoqol-bref/q11.why: Self-esteem maps WHOQOL Q11 in the catalog; disordered eating and body image get their own candidate.

whoqol-bref/q19.why: Self-esteem: "I'm never good enough for myself."

whoqol-bref/q26.why: Depression maps WHOQOL Q26 (blue mood, despair); anxiety is Anxiety.

sdg-targets/3.4.why: Promoting mental health and well-being is covered loosely by the Mind pains as a whole.

sdg-targets/3.5.why: Addiction maps SDG 3.5 in the catalog.

sdg-targets/3.5.2.why: Addiction, earlier worded "I drink more than I want to."

maxneef/identity.why: Self-esteem maps Max-Neef Identity in the catalog.

maxneef/idleness.why: Peace of mind is covered loosely by Stress and Anxiety.

gallup-elements/physical.why: Energy to get through the day is covered loosely by Tired; the catalog maps most Mind pains to Physical.

wikidata/Q696490.why: Panic attacks are covered loosely by Anxiety.

wikidata/Q748309.why: Addiction ("I can't stop something that's hurting me") covers gambling as well as substances.

wikidata/Q202387.why: Trauma maps psychological trauma; PTSD is the clinical form.

wikidata/Q181923.why: ADHD is covered loosely by Focus.

wikidata/Q223270.why: Loneliness maps Q223270 in the catalog.

wikidata/Q544006.why: Anxiety maps Q154430 (anxiety); anxiety disorder is the clinical form.

wikidata/Q3500368.why: Stress maps Q3500368 in the catalog.

wikidata/Q65076667.why: A society-wide measure, covered loosely by the societal Mental health and Drugs pains.

wikidata/Q12135.why: Mental disorder in general; each common condition has its own pain.

wikidata/Q1117179.why: Life satisfaction is covered loosely by Stuck and Depression.
